points.title: 即位
points.description: 刘彻于景帝后元三年（前141年）即位，时年十六岁，是为汉武帝。即位初期，朝政受窦太后等外戚影响，但他逐步提拔儒生与近臣，为后续改革积蓄力量。
points.descriptionEn: Liu Che ascended the throne in 141 BCE at the age of sixteen, becoming Emperor Wu of Han. In the early years of his reign, court politics were influenced by Empress Dowager Dou and other relatives, but he gradually promoted Confucian scholars and close officials, laying the groundwork for later reforms.

points.title: 内政改革与制度建构
points.description: 汉武帝在位期间推行一系列中央集权措施，包括颁布推恩令以削弱诸侯王势力、设立刺史监察地方、改革币制、实行盐铁官营与均输平准等经济政策，并采纳董仲舒建议尊崇儒术，设立太学，使儒学逐渐成为官方意识形态。
points.descriptionEn: During his reign, Emperor Wu implemented a series of centralizing measures, including the 'Pushing Grace' decree to weaken vassal kings, establishing regional inspectors to supervise localities, reforming the currency system, implementing state monopolies on salt and iron along with the equable marketing and price stabilization policies, and adopting Dong Zhongshu's proposal to honor Confucianism, establishing the Imperial Academy, which gradually made Confucianism the official ideology.

points.title: 对外征伐与疆域拓展
points.description: 汉武帝改变汉初对匈奴的和亲政策，多次派卫青、霍去病等将领北击匈奴，收复河南地，设置朔方郡，并取得河西走廊，设立武威、张掖、酒泉、敦煌四郡。又派张骞出使西域，开辟丝绸之路，加强对西域的影响。晚年对匈奴用兵失利，下轮台诏反思征伐之弊。
points.descriptionEn: Emperor Wu shifted from the early Han policy of heqin (marriage alliance) with the Xiongnu, dispatching generals such as Wei Qing and Huo Qubing in multiple campaigns against the Xiongnu, recovering the Ordos region, establishing Shuofang Commandery, and gaining the Hexi Corridor where the four commanderies of Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Dunhuang were set up. He also sent Zhang Qian to the Western Regions, opening the Silk Road and strengthening Han influence there. In his later years, after military setbacks against the Xiongnu, he issued the Luntai Edict reflecting on the burdens of expansion.

points.title: 晚年政局与托孤
points.description: 晚年发生巫蛊之祸，太子刘据被诬陷致死，朝局动荡。汉武帝随后修建思子宫以示哀悼，并立幼子刘弗陵为太子，命霍光、金日磾等辅政。后元二年（前87年）汉武帝去世，葬于茂陵。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, the witchcraft scandal led to the death of Crown Prince Liu Ju after false accusations, causing political turmoil. Emperor Wu later built the Palace of Longing for the Son to express grief, and named his young son Liu Fuling as crown prince, entrusting Huo Guang, Jin Midi, and others with regency. He died in 87 BCE and was buried at Maoling.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为汉武帝雄才大略，通过中央集权改革和对外开拓，奠定了汉朝强盛的基础，使西汉进入鼎盛时期，其尊儒政策影响了此后两千年的官方意识形态。
supporter.en: Supporters view Emperor Wu as a visionary ruler who, through centralizing reforms and territorial expansion, laid the foundation for Han prosperity and brought the Western Han to its zenith; his promotion of Confucianism shaped official ideology for the next two millennia.

critic.zh: 批评者指出汉武帝连年用兵导致民生凋敝、财政紧张，盐铁官营等政策加重百姓负担，晚年巫蛊之祸造成政治动荡，其统治手段严苛。
critic.en: Critics point out that Emperor Wu's prolonged military campaigns exhausted the populace and strained finances, policies such as state monopolies increased burdens on commoners, and the witchcraft scandal of his later years caused political instability; his rule was harsh.

objective.zh: 史学界普遍认为汉武帝是一位具有重大影响的君主，其内政改革强化了中央集权，对外战争拓展了疆域并促进了东西交流，但长期用兵和严苛政策也带来社会代价。其功过并存，是西汉由盛转衰的关键人物之一。
objective.en: Historians generally regard Emperor Wu as a highly influential ruler whose domestic reforms strengthened central authority and whose military campaigns expanded territory and promoted East-West exchange, but prolonged warfare and harsh policies also imposed social costs. His mixed legacy marks him as a pivotal figure in the Western Han's transition from prosperity to decline.

others.zh: 班固《汉书》评曰：「汉承百王之弊，高祖拨乱反正，文景务在养民，至于稽古礼文之事，犹多阙焉。孝武初立，卓然罢黜百家，表章《六经》。」
others.en: Ban Gu in the Book of Han commented: 'The Han inherited the defects of a hundred kings; Emperor Gaozu restored order, Emperors Wen and Jing focused on nurturing the people, yet matters of antiquity and ritual remained largely neglected. When Emperor Wu ascended, he decisively dismissed the Hundred Schools and honored the Six Classics.'
